description:
Get a SIIL checkout link for one shopper-selected product and size/colour.

    Read-only: returns a URL, creates no order/cart and takes no payment. The shopper
    opens the link and reviews current availability, total, delivery and pays on SIIL.
    Opening it starts a new cart and can replace an existing cart. Ask for size/colour
    before selecting a variant. Never request personal, address or card data in chat.

    Args:
        store: com (WooCommerce) or org (Medusa).
        product_id: Product ID from get_product or get_org_product, not a variant ID.
        variant_id: Exact variation ID from that product; required for all size choices.
        quantity: Integer 1-10.
        lang: com: en, en-gb, es, fr, de. org: it, pl, cs, sk, sv, da, nb, fi, nl, el, hu, ro, pt, ja.
        handle: org product slug from get_org_product, in the same language.
name: get_checkout_link
